title: phleum pratense var. nodosum
intro: Phleum pratense var. nodosum, commonly known as nodding timothy grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of nodding timothy grass include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
